evals.prompt: Refactor: "Hey guys! This is my super awesome script to check ads.txt. It's really fast and you will love it! Just type python run.py to start."
evals.expected_output: Professional Markdown documentation with a heading, a short declarative description of the tool, and a Usage section containing the command `python run.py`. No informal greetings, no superlatives, no emotional appeals.

evals.prompt: Refactor: "Amazing Slack bot for monitoring! It's super fast and sends alerts instantly!"
evals.expected_output: Professional Markdown description of a Slack monitoring bot. Uses declarative language. Contains at least one domain-relevant term (webhook, alert, or monitoring). No hype adjectives, no emoji, no exclamation marks.
assertions: output contains webhook or output contains alert or output contains monitoring

evals.prompt: Refactor: "Our brand new cutting-edge AI-powered data pipeline is really smart and processes stuff super quickly!"
evals.expected_output: Professional Markdown description of an AI-powered data pipeline. Removes hype phrases, vague capability claims, and intensifiers. Retains the factual subject matter (pipeline, AI, data processing). Contains at least one of: pipeline, process.
assertions: output contains pipeline or output contains process
